text: So let us drink... no, let us eat. To the one who eats honestly and tells the truth. Take this round, and take the money for your lunch: a guest does not pay for another man's errand.
speaker: khuazhev_aslan
direction: [hearty, generous, a cheese seller from the Caucasus, proud of his family's cheese]
